titles.title: Ronald Reagan Peace Through Strength Act of 2026
Ronald Reagan Peace Through Strength Act of 2026

To amend the Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act to prohibit the Office of Foreign Assets Control from issuing a waiver with respect to importation of Russian energy products, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence (Permanent Select), for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
